notification-without-app.reason: With no app connected the daemon posts through Alerter 26.5 with --sender fr.vjeantet.alerter. On macOS 27.0.1 that notification is never presented, as a banner or in Notification Center, so there was nothing to click. Tried: the binary copied into the world, the same binary under the home directory, the binary wrapped in a registered bundle of that identifier, a real brew install of vjeantet/tap/alerter, and a restart of usernoted and NotificationCenter. usernoted logs 'Unable to find notifier for identifier fr.vjeantet.alerter' and NotificationCenter 'Couldn't find application fr.vjeantet.alerter' each time. Run without --sender the same binary is presented as Terminal. No stand-in was used in place of a click.

unmet.single_change: Make the daemon's Alerter notification presentable on macOS 27 (it passes --sender fr.vjeantet.alerter, an identifier no application has there; without it Alerter is presented as Terminal), then run the case again on a Kitty-free Mac at the new revision.
